product.name: Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plant from Graf will treat the water, so that it is clean enough to be discharged into a water course (depending on how frequently it is being used and the manufacturer’s guidelines). However, One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plants do require a power source and requires emptying approximately every year.
The water discharged from the One2Clean Plus packaged treatment plant must meet the relevant British Standard which is BS EN 12566 for small sewage treatment plants and BS 6297:2007 for drainage fields.
Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant Process

Untreated waste enters the One2Clean tank via the inlet on the side.
Wastewater then falls directly into the biological zone where the treatment takes place, allowing micro-organisms to start the breakdown process.
Compressed air is used initially for aeration through the diffuser, intermittent to achieve the best treatment performance.
Aeration is then stopped allowing the activated waste to sink to the bottom.
Compressed air is sent through the One2Clean tank once again, extracting the cleaned water near the surface.
This water passes through a sampling point before leaving the plant, where samples can be taken to confirm the quality of effluent.
The above process occurs twice per day, each lasting 12 hours.
The sludge which builds up at the bottom of the tank must also be emptied in line with the manufacturer’s instructions
Numerous companiescan dispose of the waste, these must be a registered waste carrier

Features & Benefits

One tank with just one chamber
Less energy consumption
No mechanical elements in the wastewater
No pumps in the wastewater
No electrical components in the wastewater
Incredibly low volume of sewage sludge
Odourless, clear treated water for extraction
State-of-the-art manufacturing for maximum stability
100% watertight and corrosion-resistant
Can be installed in groundwater
Simple maintenance via an integrated, self-cleaning sampling container
More advanced control panel than the standard One2Clean
Control panel allows additional plug in retro fitting of add on systems

product.name: Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plants by Graf are always a good choice. They are flexibly adapted to meet the stricter discharge values in water protection areas. No live parts need to be installed in the Klaro E Professional. Movement processes are created by three air lift pumps that are operated using a compressor which is built into the control.
The Graf Klaro E Professional wastewater treatment system does not need consistent integration of live technology in the tank. Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plant can be flexibly adjusted to changing conditions by altering the cycle times. The air pressure holes are colour coded to avoid installation errors; the whole system just needs to be fitted to the baffle of the reservoir.

product.name: Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plants by Graf are always a good choice. They are flexibly adapted to meet the stricter discharge values in water protection areas. No live parts need to be installed in the Klaro E Professional. Movement processes are created by three air lift pumps that are operated using a compressor which is built into the control.
The Graf Klaro E Professional wastewater treatment system does not need consistent integration of live technology in the tank. Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plant can be flexibly adjusted to changing conditions by altering the cycle times. The air pressure holes are colour coded to avoid installation errors; the whole system just needs to be fitted to the baffle of the reservoir.
Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant Features & Benefits

No live technology in the reservoir
Air compressor is very durable and whisper-quiet
Flexible, as expandable
Can be switched to holiday mode
Easy to install
Low maintenance
10-year warranty on sewage reservoirs
2-year warranty on technology

product.name: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester Package
product.description: Designed for outdoor cleaning and irrigation purposes, the Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvesting system by Graf is ideal for collecting rainwater from the roof of your property and then feeding it into the underground tank via the downpipes. Available in various sizes, you can use the harvester for domestic or commercial use with the choice of either an A15 lid for pedestrian use or a B125 cast iron lid for light vehicular use.Before entering the underground tank, the water passes through a filter to remove debris, ensuring clear water for use. An underground pressure-sensitive pump is also installed. When a valve or tap is opened, the water is pumped under pressure until the valve is closed allowing the system to re-pressurise and turn off the power to the pump.Features & Benefits: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester PackageLightweight for easy handling and transportationEasy and safe to assembleA15 and B125 lid options and choice of harvester sizes availableEPDM used to profile sealings and ensure minimum life of 25 yearsConstant monitoring of production ensures consistent qualitySuitable for vehicle loading when a telescopic cast iron cover is usedTwo additional hose-lock connection extraction pointsFilter prevents leaves, moss and debris from travelling with the rainwater out of the tankFilter package 2 consists of an internal Universal Filter 3, an inflow stilling system for controlling the water inflow as well as a Spannfix connection sleeve, Rodent Guard and an Overflow siphon. The Integra Inox Submersible pump features an automatic start/stop function with a floating water extraction unit and protection against dry running.Please note: If you have an above-ground tank, you can use a pump to extract the rainwater. However, if the tank is underground, you'll need a pump to extract the rainwater. It's important to consider what you'll be using the harvested rainwater for, as this will determine whether you need a backup function for periods where little rainwater is collected.
product.variant_name: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester Package 2700L with Pedestrian Lid

product.name: Graf Carat Direct Rainwater Harvester Package
product.description: The Graf Carat Direct Rainwater Harvester Package is available in various sizes for efficient rainwater harvesting. Whether for residential or commercial use, this system is designed to collect rainwater from building roofs, providing a cost-effective and eco-friendly water source for applications such as WCs, washing machines, irrigation, and outdoor cleaning.Choose between an A15 lid suitable for pedestrian areas or a B125 cast iron lid designed for light vehicular use, tailoring the system to your specific needs. The Graf Carat Direct system incorporates an innovative filtration process that varies based on the roof's surface area, preventing leaves, moss, and debris from entering the storage tank and ensuring the purity of the collected rainwater.Features & Benefits: Graf Carat Direct Rainwater Harvester PackageOffers efficient, cost-effective and eco-friendly rainwater harvesting in various sizesFor residential and commercial applicationsChoose between A15 or B125 lids to suit pedestrian or light vehicular areasInnovative filtration prevents debris from entering the tankProvides water for applications such as WCs, washing machines, irrigation, and outdoor cleaningReliability is enhanced with a mains water backup function, ensuring uninterrupted serviceLightweight, easy to transport and safe assemblyEPDM to profile sealings lasts more than 25 yearsOnce securely stored in the tank, rainwater is easily extracted. Above-ground tanks feature a simple tap for convenient access, like a standard water butt, while underground tanks utilise pumps tailored to different applications. To enhance reliability, the Graf Carat Direct system can be equipped with a mains water backup function, ensuring uninterrupted service during periods of limited rainwater collection. Supplied with a mains water top-up unit measure the level of water in the underground tank.

product.description: Formerly Flexseal, the Fernco Rubber Flexible Drainage Adaptor Coupling Offset is designed to meet and surpass the strict demands of the drainage industry, offering a solution for various adaptation needs. product.name: Fernco EPDM Straight Plumbing Coupling
product.description: Formerly Flexseal, the Fernco EPDM Straight Plumbing Couplings are used to connect, repair and maintain drainage systems and small-diameter non-pressure pipelines. They consist of a moulded elastomeric sleeve, which is attached using medium-duty stainless steel clamping bands at both ends. The couplings are suitable for connecting plain-ended pipes, conducting repairs on existing pipe systems by replacing short sections, and joining short and cut lengths of pipe.The drain couplings come in various sizes to accommodate any pipe material with an outside diameter of up to 275mm, and there is also an option to obtain them with nitrile sleeves. What's more, they can be utilised as adaptors between pipes made of different materials and similar sizes when used in combination with a Fernco Bush.Features & Benefits: Fernco EPDM Straight Plumbing CouplingHigh-performance EPDM drain couplingLow-cost solution to damaged drainage systemsSlides on to the damaged pipe for quick & easy installationEfficient & watertight solutionAvailable in multiple sizes

It can be used to connect pipelines that are different materials such as metal, cast iron and vitrified clay pipes.Including a step-moulded elastomeric sleeve with differing diameters at each end, this adaptor coupling is fitted with two stainless steel clamping bands that offer an effective method for joining pipes that have various outer diameters. This ensures it is cost-effective, eliminating potential bush requirements. It is also suitable for connecting all new and traditional pipe systems including structural walled plastic pipes.Features & Benefits: Fernco Rubber Flexible Drainage Adaptor CouplingRange of diameters availableHigh-performance sealing qualitiesEradicates the need for grouting in most applicationsShear band ensures pipe alignment and joint flexibilityComplies with WIS 4-41-01 for all public sewers and sewers for adoptionReduces excavation workStainless steel shear band for excellent resistance to shear forces and heavy loadsDurable design with a reliable seal50-year manufacturer’s guaranteeSpecial ranges of adaptor couplings integrate an extra wide clamping band at one end and are also available for ribbed pipe systems. The clamping band fastens against two or more external ribs on the plastic ribbed pipe to ensure a high-performance seal regardless of the coupling movement or position.

product.name: Fernco Rubber Flexible Underground Standard Drainage Coupling

product.name: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain Pipes
product.description: Formerly Flexseal, Fernco Puddle Flanges serve the purpose of sealing the area around pipes that pass through concrete structures like tanks, manhole chambers, shafts, floor slabs and basements. Manufactured from sturdy EPDM, these reliable flanges are typically installed during the construction phase.When pipes pass through concrete, they do not bond to the concrete, creating a potential route for water to flow along the external surface of the pipe. However, Fernco Puddle Flanges act as a barrier, preventing water penetration in such situations. The flange is clamped onto the pipe, obstructing this direct water route. During the pouring process, the seal body is compressed, and if the concrete shrinks during curing, the rubber in the flange relaxes and maintains a seal, preventing any water flow along this path.Features & Benefits: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain PipesHighly versatile, cost-effective solution for sealing pipes which pass through concreteSuitable for use in walls, floors and ceilingsGood chemical resistanceQuick & easy to installAvailable in a wide range of sizes

Manufactured from sturdy EPDM, these reliable flanges are typically installed during the construction phase.When pipes pass through concrete, they do not bond to the concrete, creating a potential route for water to flow along the external surface of the pipe. However, Fernco Puddle Flanges act as a barrier, preventing water penetration in such situations. The flange is clamped onto the pipe, obstructing this direct water route. During the pouring process, the seal body is compressed, and if the concrete shrinks during curing, the rubber in the flange relaxes and maintains a seal, preventing any water flow along this path.Features & Benefits: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain PipesHighly versatile, cost-effective solution for sealing pipes which pass through concreteSuitable for use in walls, floors and ceilingsGood chemical resistanceQuick & easy to installAvailable in a wide range of sizes

product.name: Fernco HDPE Penstock Valve
product.description: Fernco's HDPE Penstock Valve is an effective solution for efficient water flow control in various applications, from waterways to power plants, hydropower stations, industrial effluent facilities, sewerage and wastewater treatment plants, as well as drainage and flood control projects. Constructed from corrosion-resistant and UV-stable HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene), the Fernco Penstock Valve boasts enduring quality and durability, complemented by a sturdy stainless steel frame. What sets it apart is its lightweight design, significantly lighter than alternatives, ensuring hassle-free installation without the need for grout between the frame and wall. product.name: Fernco HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle Set
product.description: Effortlessly control penstock valves with Fernco's Telescopic HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle Set. Ideal for below-ground or pit installations, these sets offer remote operation. Choose from a range of sizes to match your specific needs for seamless water flow management.To install your extension spindle, start by removing the BS cap. Then, place the extension spindle over the penstock spindle. Position the upper bracket 150mm below the deck or the top of the spindle extension. Divide the remaining brackets evenly over the length of the spindle extension, using one additional bracket for every 3m. Mark the mounting holes for the brackets to ensure the extension spindle is in the correct position. Remove the spindle extension and install the brackets as required. Finally, reinstall the spindle extension and adjust the bracket positions as needed to ensure proper alignment.Features & Benefits: Fernco HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle SetAllows remote valve control of your penstockDesigned for below-ground or pit installationsVarious sizes available to suit specific requirementsSimplifies water flow managementQuick and easy installation

product.name: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe Blank End
product.description: Easy to install, this Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe Blank End comes in a range of diameters to suit different pipes. Part of a lightweight and durable dry-jointed pipework system, it is ideal for use in various applications. It easily resists accidental external damage and vandalism, manufactured from eco-friendly and recyclable cast iron.Choose between ductile or stainless steel couplings to create a comprehensive soil and waste pipework system that handles every aspect of installation, connecting pipework to stack to underground sewer connections. Offering pipe lengths of 3m and diameters from 50mm to 400mm, the system seamlessly integrates with rainwater installations alongside Harmer Roof Outlets and is constructed easily without special installation equipment thanks to the user-friendly twin screw couplings and socketless fixing between pipes and fittings.Features & Benefits: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe Blank EndHigh tensile strengthMade from cast iron for durability and recyclabilityLightweight and easily installed with socketless fixingProducts come with resilient epoxy coatings for low maintenanceSystem is versatile across applicationsThe pipes and fittings within this system are meticulously crafted from grey iron to meet DIN 1691 (surpassing BS 1452 Grade 150 ISO 185 Grade 15). Meanwhile, the couplings are constructed using stainless steel and ductile cast iron. Pipes boast a protective exterior primer coating (minimum thickness of 40 µm) and an interior epoxy coating (minimum thickness of 120 µm). Fittings, on the other hand, are coated both externally and internally with an epoxy layer (at least 60 µm thick) to ensure minimal maintenance throughout their service life.Non-combustible without the need for fire protection collars and with high tensile strength, Harmer SML represents cutting-edge cast iron technology, proudly holding BBA certification and adhering to BS EN 877. It also has Kitemark certification and conforms to CE Mark standards.Standards & CertificationMeets British and European Standards: BS EN 877 and BS EN 14366; 2004 for excellent noise attenuationCertification: BBA Agrément certifiedCE Mark: European product conformity to harmonised standard BS EN 877 in accordance with Construction Products Regulation 2013Kitemark Certification: in accordance with BS EN877

product.name: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe
product.description: This Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe is part of a sturdy and flexible dry-jointed pipework system that is easy to install and suited to various applications. It is lightweight yet durable, making it resistant to accidental external damage and vandalism, and eco-friendly with a recyclable cast iron structure.With a choice of ductile or stainless steel couplings, the complete soil and waste pipework system covers installation from pipework connection to stack to underground sewer connection. It is compatible with rainwater installations alongside Harmer Roof Outlets with pipes in lengths of 3m and diameters ranging from 50mm to 400mm. You can construct your system using the twin screw couplings. Socketless fixing between pipe and fittings is easy but secure without special installation equipment.Features & Benefits: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain PipeLightweight but strong cast ironHigh tensile strengthEasily assembled with socketless fixingResilient primer and epoxy coatings for low maintenanceRecyclable after useSystem suited to various applicationsThe pipes and fittings from this system are crafted from grey iron to DIN 1691 (exceeds BS 1452 Grade 150 ISO 185 Grade 15), while the couplings feature stainless steel and ductile cast iron constructions. Fittings, however, are coated both externally and internally with an epoxy coating (minimum thickness 60 µm). product.name: Freefoam uPVC Soffit Board Starter J Trim 5m
product.description: This soffit starter 'J' Trim has been designed to fix soffit boards, creating a long-lasting, secure and professional finish. Protecting and preserving the underside of your roof edge, this 'J' trim is fixed at each soffit bearer before the soffits are fixed to your building. product.name: Freeflow Half Round Plastic Gutter
product.description:
Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Freeflow Plastic Ogee Gutter Internal Stopend
product.description:
The Freeflow ogee gutter system includes a traditional ‘s’ curved style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation. An additional benefit for customers is the symmetrical shape of the ogee gutter which eliminates the need to stock a range of left and right hand parts. The gutter is 135mm wide, 77mm deep and is 4m long. All ogee gutter system parts are available in white, black, brown and caramel. Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the ogee gutter system.Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

The drain shoe is designed to be slightly bigger than the downpipe to allow for maintenance. Galvanised with a coating of magnesium zinc alloy, this Round drain shoe is a member of the high-quality Magestic range by Lindab. This means that it is highly resistant to the effects of corrosion and rust. If purchased, your drain shoe will provide you with longevity use, even in coastal and marine areas – all Magestic products are tested to International Standards (ISO 9227) and possess a striking ability to fight off distortion caused by saltwater. product.name: Lindab Magestic Round Galvanised Steel Rafter Bracket
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System
10 Year Warranty

Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System
10 Year Warranty

product.name: Lindab Magestic Round Galvanised Steel Stop End
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System
10 Year Warranty

product.description:
This steel painted Half Round gutter outlet is an ideal addition to your guttering systems. With flex-flit flaps and click-fit technology to ease installation, this gutter outlet can be installed wherever you need it along the guttering run to join to your downpipe. Made from solid 5mm steel this rafter bracket is 25mm wide with 4 fixing holes. Used for securing the Rainline gutters by fixing to roof rafters, these brackets are recommended to be fixed at a maximum of 800mm interval spacing.This rafter bracket should be bent to the required angle using a bracket bender and installed to create a fall of 10mm per 3.0m run. With a range of diameters and colours to fit your gutter needs, this bracket is ideal for large or small, classic or contemporary buildings. Made from superior galvanised steel, this bracket is lightweight, durable and long-lasting, protected with a thick layer of 275g per square metre of zinc and a top layer of coloured polymer grains which provides excellent flexibility and corrosion and scratch resistance.Features & Benefits: Lindab 200mm Half Round Steel Rafter Bracket Ideal for commercial or domestic properties  Resistant to vandalism and corrosion  UV stabilised and resistant to discolouration with high-build polyester powder coating  Range of colours and diameters to fit your gutters and building needs  Affordable and cost-effective  Long-lasting with minimal thermal movement  Minimal maintenance needs  Low environmental impactProtected with an extra-durable high-build polyester coating, this bracket has an extended life expectancy to an excess of 7NULL years. This low maintenance bracket is recommended to be cleaned annually and will need the occasional top-up with paint for any scratches.

product.name: Lindab Half Round Steel Self-Locking Stop End
product.description: Lindab’s painted Half Round self-locking stop ends go at the end of guttering runs and are completely universal – they can be used both left and right-handed. Simply take off the surplus ear and use it as a push-fit connection. Painted with a defensive and quick to clean polyester paint, Lindab creates their Rainline range in an endless assortment of popular colours to match your rainwater systems. The paint coats two hardwearing layers – polymer grains that defend the products against abrasions and galvanised zinc that fends off rust and corrosion. In turn, this self-locking stop end is immensely durable and has an expected life of 70 years.Features & Benefits: Lindab Half Round Steel Self-Locking Stop End Extensive colour palette  Various gutter diameters  Affordable and high-performing  Easy to install  EPDM rubber gasket that forms tight seals without screws or sealants  Light and movable  Minimised use of raw material to help environment  UV stable  Works for domestic and commercial installations.

product.description: Lindab’s painted Half Round self-locking stop ends go at the end of guttering runs and are completely universal – they can be used both left and right-handed. Simply take off the surplus ear and use it as a push-fit connection. Painted with a defensive and quick to clean polyester paint, Lindab creates their Rainline range in an endless assortment of popular colours to match your rainwater systems. The paint coats two hardwearing layers – polymer grains that defend the products against abrasions and galvanised zinc that fends off rust and corrosion. product.name: Lindab Half Round Steel Fascia Bracket
product.description:
Ideal for securing gutters by fixing to vertical fascia boards, this solid 5mm steel-structured bracket should be installed to create a fall of 10mm per 3m run with a maximum of 800mm interval spacing. With a wide variety of colours and diameters to choose from and match your rainwater guttering system.From Lindab’s innovative Rainline range of painted steel gutters, this bracket is made from high-quality galvanised steel for a long-lasting and hard-wearing installation. Lightweight and easy to install, this bracket requires minimal maintenance with the occasional touch-up of scratched paint and recommended yearly cleaning. With a protective, thick layer of 275g per square metre of zinc, galvanising the steel surface, this bracket is corrosion resistant. With a top coating of durable high-build polyester paint, this bracket is provided with added protection and resistance to damage with superb flexibility, increasing its life expectancy to at least 70 years.  
Features & Benefits: Lindab Half Round Steel Fascia Bracket 1 oval hole and 1 standard screw holeVariety of colours and a range of gutter diametersMinimal maintenanceMade to lastVandal resistantGalvanised steel material with high-build polyester powder coatingQuick and effortless to installCost-effective solutionLow environmental impactElegant design for modern or traditional, refurbishment or new build projects
The polymer grain surface is completely UV stabilised ensuring excellent colourfastness, withstanding discolouration from damaging sun rays.

product.name: Lindab Half Round Steel Fascia Bracket
product.description:
Ideal for securing gutters by fixing to vertical fascia boards, this solid 5mm steel-structured bracket should be installed to create a fall of 10mm per 3m run with a maximum of 800mm interval spacing. With a wide variety of colours and diameters to choose from and match your rainwater guttering system.From Lindab’s innovative Rainline range of painted steel gutters, this bracket is made from high-quality galvanised steel for a long-lasting and hard-wearing installation. Lightweight and easy to install, this bracket requires minimal maintenance with the occasional touch-up of scratched paint and recommended yearly cleaning. With a protective, thick layer of 275g per square metre of zinc, galvanising the steel surface, this bracket is corrosion resistant. With a top coating of durable high-build polyester paint, this bracket is provided with added protection and resistance to damage with superb flexibility, increasing its life expectancy to at least 70 years.

The polymer grain surface is completely UV stabilised ensuring excellent colourfastness, withstanding discolouration from damaging sun rays.

Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering
Lindab steel guttering can be fitted to new builds and refurbishments to offer a subtle and light-coloured guttering system that isn’t obtrusive or distracting from the overall aesthetic of the property. It fits in perfectly between two bends in order to create an offset, or it can form two smaller pipe pieces if you cut it. Available in different colours, downpipe diameters, and lengths, this intermediate pipe is suited to a range of rainwater systems within Lindab’s Rainline range. With UV stability and anti-abrasion coating, it aims to last up to 70 years. The galvanised zinc and polymer grain layer both function to combat and deflect rusting and scratches. The polyester paint also creates a protective barrier that keeps your product intact while minimising the need for constant maintenance. Features & Benefits: Lindab Round Steel Intermediate Downpipe Durable steel coated with polyester paint for a variety of colours  A vast range of downpipe diameters and lengths  Cost-efficient and long-lasting  Simple installations and easy handling  When used in an offset can create up to 200mm projection  Stabilised against UV damage  Lower environmental impact  Suited to new or renovated modern builds and domestic or commercial applications.

product.name: Lindab Round Steel Downpipe Universal Bracket
product.description:
This universal pipe bracket can be used for fixing downpipes to the wall with screw fixes and SST spike drive-in fixes. In 1.5m interval spacing the bracket clicks into place over the downpipe, compatible with all Lindab Rainline pipes.
Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering
Lindab steel guttering can be fitted to new builds and refurbishments to offer a subtle and light-coloured guttering system that isn’t obtrusive or distracting from the overall aesthetic of the property. With a 70-year life expectancy, HB polyester painted guttering won’t split, leak, shrink or fade and the 275g layer of zinc that this steel guttering is coated in won’t discolour or rust.
Extremely low maintenance, Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering is modern and inexpensive, perfect for homeowners who need longevity and durability from their guttering system without the hassle of constant maintenance. This system only needs the occasional wipe down. The steel guttering itself is made from galvanized steel guttering, coated in zinc for extra durability, and the HB polyester paint is warrantied for 15 years. To ensure safety and security this HB polyester painted steel guttering can be fit flush to walls so people can’t use it to scale up buildings.

Conical pipe bends provide a way of overcoming facade features or to offset pipe stacks whilst maintaining the aesthetics of your Lindab Rainline gutter system. The clean lines and conical shape combine to blend in with the system whilst allowing a male/female connection. Male spigot ends of pipes and outlets can fit perfectly in the top of the bend while the bottom fits into a standard pipe.
This bend provides a 70° angle.
Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering
This system can be used for new buildings and refurbishment projects to match any external decoration. It could also be used as a subtle guttering system and installed in projects where guttering needs to appear discreet. HB polyester painted guttering from the Lindab Rainline collection is coated with a layer of 275g of zinc that won't discolour or rust, meaning this guttering system offers a solution that won't split, leak, shrink or fade.
This modern and cost-effective half round guttering system is low maintenance, requiring only the occasional wipe down. It's the perfect solution for homeowners who don't want the fuss of constant upkeep but would like to install a durable, long-lasting gutter system. Manufactured from lightweight galvanized steel, the gutters and downpipes can be fit flush to the wall in order to avoid people climbing the building.
All guttering in the HB polyester painted Lindab Rainline range comes with a 15-year warranty on the HB polyester painted coating and has a 70-year life expectancy.

product.name: Lindab Round Steel Downpipe Bend
product.description: This downpipe bend is quick and easy to install with a traditional socket which allows a male/female connection by simply pushing together pipes, with the top fitting directly to a cut end of a standard pipe and the bottom fitting directly into a standard pipe.  This downpipe bend is available in a variety of colours, diameters and angles to fit your building requirements.This lightweight, long-lasting and durable downpipe bend is made from high-performance, galvanised steel coated with a thick layer of zinc, protecting the steel core from corrosion and a top layer of coloured polymer grains with excellent flexibility and scratch resistance. This extra-durable, high-build polyester paint coating provides protection, extending the life expectancy of this downpipe bend to an excess of 70 years with low maintenance requirements. This downpipe bend requires the occasional top-up of any scratched paint and recommended annual cleaning. Cost-effective.

product.name: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset
product.description:
The steel painted round one-piece offset by Lindab is used to 'offset' a pipe stack, joining the gutter outlet or to traverse a plinth. Available with a fixed 100mm projection. Lindab’s round one-piece offset is smart and low-maintenance thanks to resilient, scratch-resistant polyester paint. It also comes with UV stability which means the colour can last for years to come. The Lindab one-piece offset is part of the popular Rainline™ range. Rainline is a sustainable range that has been tested and proven to offer the lowest carbon footprint rainwater system of any competitor. It is manufactured from 30% recycled material and is totally recyclable, meaning the environmental impact of steel is minor compared to plastic or other material. Manufacturing materials used in RainlineTM also means lasting solutions with systems being able to last up 70 years. 
Features & Benefits: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset SOKN one-piece offset with fixed 100mm projectionLow environmental impact over its lifetime than other metalsManufactured from 30% recycled material for easy recyclingUV stability helps minimise colour fadingLow maintenance saving time and costsHigh resistance to corrosion and vandalismCost-effective with a 15-year warranty as part of the Rainline™ painted systems range
Please note: 15-year warranty does not apply to unpainted finishes. Use of the Lindab steel painted one-piece offset in coastal regions where salt water is present is also not advised as it can risk a corrosive reaction. In this instance, a coated system should be used.

product.name: Lindab Magestic Rectangular Galvanised Steel Regular Water Hopper
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System

Dimensions
Length: 250mm.Width: 150mm.Height: 150mm.

product.name: Lindab Steel Downpipe Self Cleaning Leaf Trap
product.description:
Self cleaning leaf filter in HD polythene for down pipes.
When it comes to creating beautiful, environmentally friendly and maintenance free buildings, using the right materials is everything. The Lindab Rainline Steel Rainwater system uses the very best in lightweight galvanised steel to create a contemporary, cost effective and eco-friendly guttering system that won't shrink, split or leak and looks great too.
Each piece of core steel is coated with 275g zinc per square metre, a naturally self-healing coating that won't discolour or rust. The coating on both our High Build Polyester and Aluzinc guttering systems, are guaranteed for 15 years with a life expectancy in excess of 70 years.
Rainline is ideal for modern and traditional buildings for both refurbishments and new build projects. Gutters and downpipes simply push together without the need for any special tools or sealants.
The SLS fits directly into a 110mm Drain point, simply slides inside.
When you have a different diameter downpipe entering the SLS from above, you will need to purchase a BUTK drain shoe which allows for this connection to be achieved.
Properties

Steel is the ultimate material for roof-drainage systems.
It is much lighter than cast iron, is easier to handle than aluminium and offers minimal thermal movement compared to plastic (which can move and crack causing leaks).
Lindab's steel also has the lowest CO2 impact of any competitor.

Low maintenance

The only maintenance required is an occasional wipe or wash down.
Easy assembly and installation guarantee a long service life.

Vandal resistant

Highly resistant to attack from vandals - can be fixed flush to a wall to prevent anyone climbing up the downpipe

Minimum environmental impact

Tests have proven that Rainline steel systems reflect the lowest cradle-to-grave impact by minimizing the use of raw materials, components, energy, packaging and transport.

Cost-effective solution

Competitively priced against leading plastic systems and inexpensive compared with aluminium and cast iron.

A limited range of Rainline products are available in uncoated copper. The finish is highly desirable and provides excellent corrosion resistance once it has transitioned to a greenish verdigris patina.
Rainline is ideal for modern and traditional buildings for both refurbishments and new build projects. Gutters and downpipes simply push together without the need for any special tools or sealants.
Low maintenance

The only maintenance required is an occasional wipe or wash down.

Vandal resistant

Highly resistant to attack from vandals - can be fixed flush to a wall to prevent anyone climbing up the downpipe.

Cost-effective solution

Competitively priced against leading plastic systems and inexpensive compared with aluminium and cast iron.

Quick and easy to install

Lindab's smart design solutions saves installation time for professionals and makes DIY installation easy. The pipes simply push together, snap mounting outlets, self-sealing stop ends, and click lock gutter joints and pipe brackets are just some of the unique product features of Lindab Rainline.

product.name: Lindab Airy AIRYB Vent Valve (Body Only)
product.description: Designed for wall or ceiling installation in new-builds or as an upgrade replacement, the Airy AIRYB Vent Valve by Lindab helps improve your indoor climate. It features a smart grip function which ensures easy installation, plus unique sound performance that ensures optimum sound level. The valve consists of two parts, the valve body (AIRYB) and the flat front plate (AIRYFP - sold separately). It's a slim, effective air valve with unlimited applications and has the lowest sound power level on the market. To install, fix the valve body to the duct system or a valve socket via flexible spring wings. The front plate is then attached to the valve body via springs. In addition to their design, size variations are available to ensure you have the right one for your project requirements. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Stop-End
product.description: Designed to prevent rainwater from continuously flowing around your building’s gutters, this Half Round stop-end assists the direction of water towards a gutter or running outlet into the rainwater system below. Available in a variety of factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder colour coatings and in a range of diameters with your choice of left or right-handed stop-end.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Stop-End
product.description: Designed for use with the Deep Run Aqualine range of extruded aluminium guttering, this Deep Run stop-end is ideal for areas that experience higher than average rainfall or in situations where large quantities of water need to be dealt with.Created to stop water from flowing around the gutter continuously, this stop-end can direct the water into a running or gutter outlet through to the rainwater system below. Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications, it is part of a compact yet efficient rainwater system that fully accommodates free linear thermal movement.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Stop-EndSuitable for both flush and projecting eaves applicationsVariety of colours to choose from with left or right handed optionsNeat appearance with secret fix bracketryMinimal maintenance requirementsLightweight and easy to handle and installDurable and non-corrodibleEnvironmentally friendly and recyclableMade in the UK to British StandardsLife expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areasContributing to enhanced performance and high flow capacity, this stop-end comes in a variety of monochrome colours to choose from. Displaying smooth lines and intricate detailing, it is perfect for complementing and transforming the appearance and architectural character of your contemporary designed building. Made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium, it is available left or right handed to complete your building’s guttering requirements.Straightforward to install providing a neat appearance, this stop-end is light and easy to handle. With secret fix bracketry and all-weather ‘dry’ jointing, the Deep Run gutters can drop and lock onto concealed brackets where internal joints are aligned. They are then locked using slide bars with single front lock bars to ensure a completely secure installation.Standards & CertificationBBA-approved process: factory-applied polyester powder coatingsMade with aluminium extrusions: 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573:  BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101Please note: This item is non-returnable due to being Special Order, Made to Measure or for hygiene reasons. product.description: Designed to support the extruded aluminium Aqualine Modern gutter system, this fascia bracket is light and easy to install, providing a fully secure installation with smooth lines and intricate detailing for your modern designed building. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded External Angle
product.description:
This external moulded angle is part of Alumasc's 'Aqualine' range of guttering products, combining traditional design elements and aesthetics with highly durable modern materials to produce an excellent all-rounder for your next domestic guttering project. Emulating the moulded guttering profiles of period cast iron, these external angles are a perfect addition to traditional properties looking to keep their Victorian charm.However, period design no longer means putting up with the cost and added installation woes of cast iron. This range of guttering products is constructed using recycled aluminium and a long-lasting polyester powder coating approved by the British Board of Agrément (BBA). Under the right conditions, this durable combination of materials can last up to 40 years in suburban and rural areas, making for a durable and reliable system. In addition, the Aqualine range is lightweight and easy to handle, taking into account heat warping thanks to a clever notched design and keeping a watertight seal with sliding lock bars and dry joint seals.
Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded External AngleDurable powder-coated aluminium constructionLong-lasting performance, up to 40 years of life in suburban and rural areasBritish Board of Agrément-approved designWatertight and secure seals thanks to sliding lock barsNotched design takes into account heat warping in higher temperaturesStylish traditional 'moulded' profile is perfect for period properties

This external moulded angle is part of Alumasc's 'Aqualine' range of guttering products, combining traditional design elements and aesthetics with highly durable modern materials to produce an excellent all-rounder for your next domestic guttering project. Emulating the moulded guttering profiles of period cast iron, these external angles are a perfect addition to traditional properties looking to keep their Victorian charm.However, period design no longer means putting up with the cost and added installation woes of cast iron. This range of guttering products is constructed using recycled aluminium and a long-lasting polyester powder coating approved by the British Board of Agrément (BBA). Under the right conditions, this durable combination of materials can last up to 40 years in suburban and rural areas, making for a durable and reliable system. In addition, the Aqualine range is lightweight and easy to handle, taking into account heat warping thanks to a clever notched design and keeping a watertight seal with sliding lock bars and dry joint seals.
Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded External AngleDurable powder-coated aluminium constructionLong-lasting performance, up to 40 years of life in suburban and rural areasBritish Board of Agrément-approved designWatertight and secure seals thanks to sliding lock barsNotched design takes into account heat warping in higher temperaturesStylish traditional 'moulded' profile is perfect for period properties

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Modern Stop-End
product.description: This modern stop-end is designed for use with the modern profile Aqualine extruded aluminium gutter system range for a sleek and contemporary appearance with the gutter fitting nearly hidden from view. This stop-end creates an end to a run of guttering in order to prevent rainwater from continuously running around the entire building and helps to direct water into a running outlet or gutter outlet.Made from durable, aluminium, this stop-end is part of an efficient and compact rainwater system and is suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications. This modern stop-end is perfect for complementing and enhancing the architectural character and appearance of contemporary designed buildings with smooth lines and intricate detailing. Designed to fully accommodate free linear thermal movement, this stop-end contributes to a high flow capacity for enhanced performance. Available in a range of colours, sizes and left or right-handed ends, your choice of stop-end can match your building’s guttering needs.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Modern Stop-EndManufactured in the UK Made to British standards with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  Made from environmentally friendly and recyclable aluminium  Robust and non-corrodible aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/ suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/ marine areas  Easy to install with all-weather ‘dry’ jointing and minimal maintenance after installation  Clean appearance and enhances buildings with smooth lines, intricate details and secret fix bracketry  A wide range of colours and sizes to choose from  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications with a high flow capacity for enhanced performance  BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatingsThis lightweight and easy to install modern stop-end uses a unique dry jointing system to give a completely clean external appearance where the gutters drop and lock onto concealed brackets with internal joints that are aligned and locked using slide bars. This fully secure gutter system requires the use of single front lock bars and requires minimal maintenance once installed.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Stop-End
product.description: This lightweight and durable stop-end is available in two different sizes, a wide selection of colours and left or right-handed, depending on the side of your installation needs. Made from recyclable aluminium, this stop-end is part of the Aqualine range of extruded aluminium gutter systems, providing a compact and efficient rainwater system.This moulded stop-end is designed to create an end to a run of guttering, preventing rainwater from running around the entire building and helping to direct water into a running outlet or gutter outlet. Ideal for enhancing and complementing the appearance and architectural character of your building, this moulded stop-end is part of the Aqualine system which provides smooth lines and intricate detailing to contemporary designed buildings. With a high flow capacity for enhanced performance, this stop-end is suited to both flush and projecting eaves applications and is designed to fully accommodate free linear thermal movement.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Stop-EndBBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Manufactured in the UK  Based on aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573:, BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  Made from long-lasting aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas  Lightweight and easy to install with concealed brackets for a clean appearance  Durable and non-corrodible with minimal maintenance once installed  Enhances the appearance of buildings with smooth lines and intricate details with a range of colours to choose from  High flow capacity for enhanced performance  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications  Environmentally friendly and made from recyclable aluminiumThis easy to handle and install moulded stop-end uses a unique dry jointing system with secret fix bracketry to conceal the site fixing and give a completely clean external appearance. This stop-end can drop and lock onto the concealed brackets where internal joints are aligned and lock using slide bars, located at the front and rear.  This moulded stop-end requires minimal maintenance once installed and is completely secure.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Starter Pack
product.description: This Alumasc Aqualine starter pack contains P80 joint seal lubricant, 2 jointing tools, 10 spare slide locks, 20 spare number 12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and 20 shims for filling gaps. This includes all the necessary tools to help you to commence an easy and successful installation process of the Moulded extruded aluminium gutter system.This starter pack ensures a quick and easy installation using a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system with concealed site fixing and jointing. This starter pack secures intricate details and smooth lines with a modern appearance for contemporary designed buildings with a completely clean outer appearance.  This lightweight and easy to handle, starter pack ensures the Moulded gutters can be locked and dropped into place onto concealed brackets with aligned and locked internal joints using lock bars located at the front and rear. This safeguards the entire gutter system is completely secure while allowing free linear thermal movement at every joint.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Starter PackQuick and easy to install your Moulded gutter system  Once support brackets have been fixed to the building fabric all remaining assembly is by a simple clip fix  Helps to enhance your building with intricate details, smooth lines and secret fix bracketry, giving a completely clean appearance  Environmentally friendly and made from durable, long-life, recyclable aluminium  Lightweight and easy to handle materials  Minimal maintenance required  Available in two different gutter diameter sizes  Made from long-lasting aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)This Moulded guttering system has a high flow capacity for enhanced performance, while this starter pack is suited to help install both flush and projecting eaves applications.  Once installed, this gutter system requires minimal maintenance, made from long-lasting, durable and non-corrodible aluminium. Available in two different sizes, this starter pack is quick and easy to help you with your installation needs.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Fascia Bracket
product.description: This Box Fascia Bracket has been manufactured to provide support for the Aqualine Box extruded aluminium gutter system. Made from durable and non-corrodible aluminium, this fascia bracket has a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/ marine areas) with minimal maintenance required.This lightweight, straightforward bracket is easy to install and handle. Once fixed to the building fabric, the only remaining assembly is by a simple clip fix, dropping and locking the guttering onto this concealed bracket with locked and aligned internal joints using lock bars to ensure completely secure guttering. This fascia bracket uses a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system to give a clean external appearance contributing to the smooth lines and intricate detailing to enhance and complement the appearance and architectural character of contemporary designed buildings.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Fascia BracketManufactured in the UK to British standards  Manufactured with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  Available in a variety of colours to match your gutters  Provides support for the Aqualine Box extruded aluminium gutter system  Made from recyclable aluminium and is environmentally friendly  Manufactured from durable and non-corrodible aluminium with minimal maintenance required  Available in a range of diameters  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves  Easy to install and lightweightSuitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications and available in a wide range of sizes and in a variety of colours with BBA approved factory-applied polyester powder coatings to match your gutter system.  This Box fascia bracket is part of a compact and efficient rainwater system that enhances high flow capacity and performance and fully accommodates free linear thermal movement at every joint. The Aqualine Box guttering, supported by this fascia bracket has a box profile with a rectangular trough shape to maximise water flow capacity and gives a striking angular appearance with a uniform shape.

product.description: This Box stop-end is made to stop water from flowing around your building’s gutters continuously and helps direct the water into a running or gutter outlet into the rainwater system below. Designed to fit with the Box Aqualine extruded aluminium guttering system, this stop-end has a box profile with a rectangular trough shape and maximises the capacity of water flow while providing a striking angular appearance and uniformity in shape.This Aqualine stop-end displays intricate detailing and smooth lines, enhancing and complementing the appearance and architectural character of contemporary designed buildings. Ideal for both flush and projecting eaves applications, this stop-end is part of an efficient and compact rainwater system. This stop-end enhances performance and high flow capacity while fully accommodating free linear thermal movement. Made from non-corrodible and durable aluminium, this stop-end is available in a variety of colours, range of sizes and left or right-handed.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Stop-EndManufactured in the UK to British standards  Manufactured with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  Made with BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Environmentally friendly and made from recyclable aluminium  Made from non-corrodible and durable aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/ suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/ marine areas)  Easy to install and light in weight to handle  Little to no maintenance after installation  Gives a clean appearance, enhancing buildings with smooth lines, intricate details and secret fix bracketry  Available in a wide variety of colours and sizes to choose from with left and right-handed stop-ends  Has a high flow capacity for enhanced performance and suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applicationsThis, lightweight and easy to handle and fix, stop-end uses a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system giving a completely clean external appearance. The Aqualine Box gutters can drop and lock onto concealed brackets with aligned and locked internal joints using lock bars located at the front and rear, ensuring a completely secure guttering stop-end.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Starter Pack
product.description:
This box starter pack is mainly manufactured from aluminium, and is part of the Aqualine range of aluminium guttering from Alumasc. With years of experience in the guttering and rainwater system industry, Alumasc create a range of products that, by using new technologies and manufacturing techniques, not only meet industry standards, but also surpass expectations in terms of quality, performance and style.
This starter pack has been designed specifically for use with box profile guttering from the Aqualine range. The box profile is a contemporary design with sharp angular lines to create a strong visual statement, as well as maximum capacity and efficient flow rates.
The starter pack has been designed to provide you with everything you need to install box profile Aqualine guttering securely, to create a durable and weathertight run of guttering on your property. The box profile starter pack consists of 10 spare lock bars, 20 shims, 2 jointing tools, 20 no.12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and P80 joint and seal lubricant, to create a pristine, built to last finish.
Why choose Alumasc Aqualine guttering?
The Alumasc Aqualine range of guttering is part of the contemporary aluminium rainwater range from Alumasc.
Performance and design
The Alumasc Aqualine guttering system features a number of characteristics that make it one of the highest performing gutter systems available. The design of Aqualine takes into account potential dangers of cracking and splitting due to thermal movement, so at every joint across the gutter system thermal movement can occur without causing damage.
The Aqualine gutter system has also been designed to be installed with concealed fixing and jointing, which not only helps to create a clean external appearance, but also helps minimise the potential for leaks to occur. This is further aided by the dry joint seals, which are secured by sliding lock bars for maximum watertightness.
Installation
The installation process of Alumasc Aqualine is quick and easy, aided by the fact that the gutters are lightweight and easy to handle. Support brackets simply need to be fixed to the building fabric, and then a simple clip fix is all that is required to secure the gutter in place.
Aesthetics
The Aqualine range is available in a vast range of colours, sizes and profiles, which allow a high level of customisation in order to create the perfect look for your project. Whether you’re looking to create a subtle guttering run with relatively traditional profiles, or you want to make the gutters a feature, in bright colours and contemporary profiles, the Alumasc Aqualine range will have exactly what you are looking for, with BBA approved polyester powder coatings, and including all the accessories you’ll need to create a single, uniform look.
Environmentally friendly
The Aqualine guttering range is a compact and efficient rainwater system that is manufactured from 100% recyclable aluminium in the UK. Additionally, the Aqualine guttering system has a life expectancy of 40 years or more in rural or suburban areas, and up to 25 years in industrial and marine environments. This means that not only are less gutter profiles required over time due to their long lasting design, when they are finally replaced they can be recycled.

product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: Designed to collect rainwater from the bottom of your roof, this gutter assembly provides you with a gutter run that channels the water away into a downpipe and into the rainwater system below. Innovative technology has gone into the Aqualine gutter collection by Alumasc to create products that hold up to high standards. Featuring strong aluminium constructions that combat corrosion and rusting, the Aqualine range pre-empts damage that can occur during thermal movement and is therefore designed to allow the space for this process. Not only light and ideal for long-term use, but this guttering also looks tidy with hidden bracketry, as well as withstands leaks with sliding locks for joints. With an assortment of sizes, colours, and models, this box running outlet can be picked to perfectly match your Aqualine box guttering. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Running OutletEasy to install and manoeuvre  Recyclable aluminium that lasts a long time  Involves capacity for high flow  BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved  Made in the UK.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: Supplied with a moulded gutter and applicable brackets, union clips, and sidelocks for reliable and unwavering installation, this 3m moulded gutter assembly allows you to set up an Alumasc aluminium gutter run within the rest of an Aqualine system.Aqualine is one of Alumasc’s several high-performing rainwater ranges. The moulded profile is one of three, and poses a modern take on the ogee gutter system. It suits an assortment of contemporary builds with unique styles and sleek, undetectable fixings while being versatile in eave applications (either flat against the eave or projected from it). Even better, the moulded range still accommodates high-level flow capacities and has the potential to last up to 40 years. 3m gutter assemblies are an excellent and cost-efficient means of applying your gutter run that exceeds expectations and conforms to high British standards.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded 3m Gutter AssemblyIncludes multiple polyester powder coloured coatings that are BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved  Moulded profile for cooperation with the moulded range  British standard aluminium extrusions (BS 1474: 1972, material 6063, T6)  Produced in the UK  Includes fixings for sturdiness and support  Doesn’t require extensive maintenance  Can be recycled.

product.name: Alumasc GX Smooth 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: With this 3m gutter assembly, you will be able to successfully and easily install a guttering run that works in perfect tandem with the aluminium GX smooth guttering range from Alumasc. Including the appropriate union clips and brackets to fit the provided 3m gutter run, as well as slide locks for joints where they are necessary. The GX range is one of many brilliant guttering ranges by Alumasc. product.name: Alumasc GX Smooth Internal Angle
product.description: Manufactured as part of the pressed aluminium GX Smooth gutter system, this internal angle has been designed for simple jointing for a sleek appearance without the requirement for sole support brackets and visible screw fixing. This high water-flow capacity internal angle is suitable for both traditional and modern buildings.With sharp-angled bends and an internal returned lip, this internal angle can be exposed or designed to be compatible with a Skyline fascia system and can offer an all-aluminium eaves/ soffit solution. This lightweight and easy to install internal angle uses wet sealed and bolted joints for a well-proven, simple installation method with a straightforward, screw fixing with concealed bracketry. Adapting to thermal movement at every corner and joint, this internal angle has been constructed to reduce the potential for heat damage, avoiding cracks or splits in the gutter system.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Smooth Internal AngleFully engineered in the UK to British Standards  Pressed from sheet aluminium to British Standards  Available in two different angles to choose from  Coated in graphite-coloured factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder  Made from durable, non-corrosive aluminium with minimal maintenance required and a long life expectancy  Made from lightweight, recyclable aluminium  Suited for installations where maximum capacity gutters are needed  Easy to fix with a well-proven, straightforward method  Created for simple jointing with a smooth appearance without the need for sole support brackets and visible screw fixing  Suitable for corners of buildings or avoiding protrusions or obstacles where the angles of the roofline changeManufactured from durable, corrosion-resistant, pressed aluminium, this internal angle requires a minimum amount of maintenance and is expected to last 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Available in two different angles of your choice, this internal angle will fit your box profile gutter system. This graphite-coloured internal angle is made with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings.

This internal angle has been designed as part of the pressed aluminium GX Moulded gutter system.Durable and fully engineered, this box section internal angle gutter has been designed for a traditional, well-proven method of simply wet sealing and bolting joints fixed directly onto the building fabric and is suitable for traditional or modern buildings. Perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required, this internal angle is designed to fully accommodate thermal movement at every joint, reducing the risk of cracking or splitting through heat damage. Providing an all-aluminium eaves/ soffit solution, this internal angle is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit solution and requires a simple screw fixing with bracketry which is generally concealed after installation.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Moulded Internal AngleManufactured in the UK to British Standards and pressed from sheet aluminium  Available in two different colours with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium for minimal maintenance and a long-lasting installation  Made from environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Ideal for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required  Available in a range of angles and diameters  Lightweight and easy to install with a well-proven and simple method   Wet jointed and fixed directly to the building fabricAvailable in a range of diameters and angles, this lightweight internal angle is made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas) with minimal maintenance required after installation. Available in your choice of two colours, this internal angle is coated with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder.

product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded External Angle
product.description: With 90º or 135º options for your guttering requirements, this external angle features a moulded profile that renders it ideal for the GX moulded collection of aluminium guttering systems from Alumasc. This moulded external angle is a terrific and efficient way of directing guttering around the corners of builds, either modern or more traditional, and creating an unbroken path that accommodates rainwater flow even with shifts in the roofline. You can install this to the rest of your moulded gutter with GX moulded union clips and, alongside Alumasc’s fellow aluminium products, it can be recycled once its long-term use has been achieved. As well as ensuring a clean and neat aesthetic once installed, this high-quality technology allows for any thermal expansion and contraction that may arise during usage.

product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded Standard Running Outlet
product.description: A vital part of the admirable GX aluminum range for guttering systems, this moulded running outlet makes for a wonderful means of attaching the downpipe to the guttering, therefore allowing rainfall to be transported. The well-received GX collection is one of many Alumasc quality ranges. Refined and sleek in fixings, as well as manufactured from fantastically sturdy aluminium, GX products fashion together long-lasting guttering that resides easily on traditional and modern applications. Corrosion remains a minimal concern while the aluminium guttering values moveability for thermal-related adjustment. With a moulded profile utilised in this running outlet, it is intricately designed to join the GX moulded guttering assortment – this range compensates for heavier rainfall and builds that prove bigger in size, with items that are larger. product.name: Alumasc GX Smooth External Angle
product.description: Designed in conjunction with the GX Smooth pressed aluminium gutter system, this external angle is suited to fit around corners or protrusions for your gutters to fit neatly onto your building. This durable and non-corrosive aluminium external angle is expected to last 40 years in suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years in marine/industrial areas. You can choose from two different angles to fit your building needs.

product.description: Created for functional use alongside the innovative variety of GX aluminium gutter products, this smooth standard running outlet is specially crafted to let rainwater flow into the system by connecting gutter runs to downpipes. product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part Offset
product.description: This two part circular offset angles at 135º in order to build a connection between the running outlet and the downpipe of your Flushjoint system, in turn letting the downpipe fix flush against the wall. Made from resilient and quality aluminium, the Flushjoint downpipe collection by Alumasc can be paired and used in tandem with suitably sized items from the Aqualine, GX, and Heritage guttering ranges on recent or refurbished builds. With hidden spigot connections, fittings are designed to seamlessly attach both together and to surfaces, resulting in a neat and tidy finish. Just as the rest of the Flushjoint range, this two part offset is rigid and durable to prevent cracks and leaks. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part OffsetElaborate colour palette, all coated in BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder  UK made extruded aluminium (6063 T6 alloy) that meets British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 755)  Various sizes available  Recyclable to reduce waste.

product.description: This two part circular offset angles at 135º in order to build a connection between the running outlet and the downpipe of your Flushjoint system, in turn letting the downpipe fix flush against the wall. Made from resilient and quality aluminium, the Flushjoint downpipe collection by Alumasc can be paired and used in tandem with suitably sized items from the Aqualine, GX, and Heritage guttering ranges on recent or refurbished builds. With hidden spigot connections, fittings are designed to seamlessly attach both together and to surfaces, resulting in a neat and tidy finish. Just as the rest of the Flushjoint range, this two part offset is rigid and durable to prevent cracks and leaks.
